name: TwexAPI
description: REST API for public X (Twitter) data: advanced search, profiles, timelines, followers and replies, billed per result.
notes: Self-serve: sign up and get an API key without an X developer account. New accounts get 20,000 free Credits for 7 days, then pay as you go, so free is set to false. Public docs at docs.twexapi.io; OpenAPI 3.1 spec at twexapi.io/openapi.json; MCP server listed in the Official MCP Registry as io.twexapi/mcp.
